name: Pixel Tablet
notes: Disconnect the tablet from its Charging Speaker Dock before flashing. Back up data before changing the bootloader.

modes.fastboot: Power off. Hold Volume Down and press Power until Fastboot Mode appears. Leave it there; do not press Start.

unlock.text: Enable OEM unlocking first. Unlocking the bootloader erases the tablet; confirm on the tablet with the volume keys and Power.
steps: Back up everything. Unlocking erases the tablet.
Settings › About tablet: tap Build number until Developer options turn on.
Settings › System › Developer options: enable OEM unlocking; an internet connection may be required once.
The installer unlocks the bootloader; confirm on the tablet with the volume keys and Power.
hints: Update the stock OS first so the firmware is current.
Disconnect the Charging Speaker Dock before using USB; the tablet cannot use the dock and USB port at the same time.
Use a good cable and connect directly without a USB hub.

recovery.text: Back to stock: use Google's Android Flash Tool at flash.android.com. With the bootloader unlocked, first erase the GrapheneOS verified-boot key with `fastboot erase avb_custom_key`; see https://grapheneos.org/install/web#replacing-grapheneos-with-the-stock-os.
